steps.detail: Open Canva.com and enter your credentials.
Navigate to the homepage and choose a template that suits your needs.
Drag and drop elements, change colors, and add text to personalize your design.
Click on the 'Save' icon and choose how to export your design (PDF, PNG, JPEG, etc.).
Optionally, share your design directly from Canva or export it to other platforms like email, social media, or Google Drive.
